lessons.title: Synthetic interval compatible with the null
lessons.question: Does a fictional documentation change alter accepted task completion?
lessons.population: Synthetic library maintainers, not actual participants
lessons.risks: Security, license incompatibility, search failure and dependency maintenance
lessons.validity_threats: No observations, randomized assignments, external data or causal evidence
lessons.negative_findings: Synthetic interval includes zero; this is not proof of no effect
lessons.practical_cost: License auditing, maintainer verification and ongoing dependency cost unknown
lessons.suggested_experiment: Prospectively freeze maintenance tasks, run an ethically reviewed reuse-first versus generate-first comparison and measure verified outcomes and total cost
lessons.stop_rule: Stop on security/license violations or worsening independently accepted outcomes
